domain: Corporate physical access control system with badge and PIN authentication.

glossary.definition: Maximum duration of 3 seconds the card reader waits for a valid card signal before returning an unreadable status to the access control system.

business_rules.rule: Each access attempt at the turnstile must be logged with a timestamp, turnstile identifier, and outcome code (granted, denied, timeout) in the central access log within 1 second of the event.
